'''Dana Dregond''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] native of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamori/Legends|Kamori]]. A [[Glanthe]] master, she was the [[Glanthe school]]'s master [[Artist/Legends|painter]] and was designated as a one of Kamori's "living treasures," a rare honor bestowed upon the masters of the arts, around [[9 BBY/Legends|9 BBY]]. She was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] when [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquakes]] sundered [[City/Legends|cities]] all over the [[Zethusian plains]].
